anchors.text: Incident Commander sends a customer-impact summary to Executive Review before the recovery decision is published.
The recovery decision names the accountable Operations Lead.
Release Exception goes to Risk Assessment before Change Owner approval.
Approved Release Exception is recorded in the Deployment Register.
Vendor Intake goes to Security Screening before Contract Setup.
Contract Setup is owned by Procurement Operations.
Access Request goes to Entitlement Review before Manager Approval.
Manager Approval creates an Access Record for the requester.
Duty Manager, Incident Lead and Communications Owner are the existing escalation roles.
Captured, Verified and Retained are the existing evidence states.
Catalog Analyst submits Version 7 to Product Steward before Catalog Publish.
Only Version 7 is authorized for this edit.
When Evidence Sync is Unavailable, grounded publishing is blocked while Manual Notes remain available.
Retry Sync may continue only after Evidence Sync is restored.
Canvas Save Failed preserves the editable diagram and offers Retry Save.
After repeated save failure, the case is routed to Workspace Support.
Change Implemented goes to Verify Outcome. If Outcome accepted? is Yes, Record Closure then Publish Change Note. If No, Plan Remediation then Recheck Outcome.
Privacy Alert goes to Assess Exposure. If External notice required? is Yes, Notify Privacy Lead then Send Notice. If No, Document Assessment then Monitor Follow-up.
Service Triage sends an affected component to Restoration Work before Service Verification.
Service Verification records the restoration result in the Incident Timeline.
